name: Attempt Training.
description:
Characters gain EXP not only from battles 
but also from Training. 

So stop your slacking, and get Training from the 
"Team" menu!

name: Attempt Awakening.
description:
Awakening characters unleashes their 
dormant powers, which in turn raises their stats. 

Collect Awakening Medals and tap into 
their hidden power!

name: Attempt Z-Awakening.
description:
Maxing out a character's Lv. and collecting 
all necessary Awakening Medals allow you 
to perform a Z-Awakening, raising their max level 
and powering up their Type. 
Perform a Z-Awakening!

name: Clear a stage with 5000 Zeni acquired.
description:
You'll need Zeni to Train or Awaken characters. 

You can obtain Zeni on the map of each stage or 
by defeating enemies. 

Clear any stage with at least 5000 Zeni acquired!

name: Acquire 50 Support Items.
description:
The blue Hoi-Poi Capsules that appear on the map 
give you Support Items. 

Acquire 50 or more Support Items from the stages!

name: Acquire 50 Training Items.
description:
The red Hoi-Poi Capsules that appear on the map 
give you Training Items or Training Locations. 

Acquire 50 or more Training Items from the stages! 

* Training Locations excluded.

name: Acquire 50 Awakening Medals.
description:
The purple Hoi-Poi Capsules that appear 
on the map give you Awakening Medals. 

Acquire 50 or more Awakening Medals 
from the stages!

name: Sell a character.
description:
You can sell characters in exchange for Zeni.

Try selling a character from the "Team" menu!

name: Use a Training Item.
description:
Using a Training Item when 
Training earns the character 
more EXP. 
Try using a Training Item if 
you're having trouble leveling up 
a character!

name: Use a Training Location.
description:
Training at any location other than Wasteland 
earns characters more EXP. 

The more Training Partners you use, the greater 
the location's effect!

name: Use a Recovery Drink.
description:
The simplest way to treat low HP is to use 
the Support Item "Recovery Drink"! 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use a Super Recovery Drink.
description:
Use the Support Item "Super Recovery Drink" 
to restore 6000 HP. Well, it's better than losing! 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use Hercule.
description:
You can use the Support Item "Hercule" to gain 
one more Ki if you need a little more Ki to launch 
a Super Attack in battle. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use Cargo.
description:
The Support Item "Cargo" can restore 25% HP. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use a Ki Sphere color-changing item.
description:
The Support Items "Oolong" and "Puar" can 
change the color of Ki Spheres. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name:
Use the World 
Tournament Announcer.
description:
The Support Item "World Tournament Announcer" 
can increase the ATK of a certain Type for 1 turn. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use Videl.
description:
The Support Item "Videl" can increase the DEF 
of a certain Type for 1 turn. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use Ranfan.
description:
The Support Item "Ranfan" can reduce 
all enemies' ATK. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when 
you lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Log in for 2 days in total.
description: Log in to the game for 2 days in total!

name: Log in for 3 straight days.
description:
There are 2 kinds of login bonuses. 

Consecutive Login Bonuses are rewarded for 
consecutive daily logins. 

Log in for 3 straight days!

name: Log in for 7 straight days.
description:
Mission rewards are instantly yours to use, 
but login bonuses get sent to your Gift Box. 

Don't forget to go collect them! 

Log in for 7 straight days!

name: Create a Device Transfer Code.
description:
You never know when you'll 
need a Device Transfer Code. 
I bet it'll come in handy if you 
need to contact customer 
support! 
Create one by selecting 
"Device Transfer" from the 
MENU.

name: Collect 3 Dragon Balls.
description:
Find all the Dragon Balls lying around the 
Quest map yet? 

Just tap a grayed-out one on the "Shenron" 
screen to learn its location. 

Let's see if you can find 3 to start with!

name: Collect 7 Dragon Balls.
description:
You can't do anything with the Dragon Balls 
until you have all 7. 

Collect all 7 Dragon Balls!

name: Have Shenron grant 1 wish.
description:
With all 7 Dragon Balls in your possession, 
you can have a wish granted. 

Summon Shenron from the "Shenron" screen.

name: Use a team of all the same Type.
description:
Enemies from each stage of the event "Battle 
for Awakening Medals" are of a single Type. 
A team made up of characters of the same Type 
could be a powerful counter to such opponents. 

Build a team with characters of the same Type 
and try to clear one of the stages! 

* This mission will not be completed when 
you lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use 100 STA Points.
description:
1 STA is restored every 5 minutes. 

You can see how much time is left before the 
next STA is recovered at the top of the screen. 

Consume at least 100 STA!

name: Reach Rank 10.
description:
Clearing a stage earns you Rank EXP, 
which raises your Rank. 

Your maximum STA will increase as 
your Rank is raised. 

Try to reach Rank 10!

name: Get Trade Points.
description:
Trade any items you don't need 
for Trade Points at Baba's Shop!

name: Use Trade Points.
description: Buy something at Baba's Shop using Trade Points!

name:
Expand the product range of 
Baba's Shop.
description:
Unlock a Trade Slot at Baba's Shop 
using Trade Points!

name:
Further expand the product range 
of Baba's Shop.
description:
Unlock a Trade Slot at Baba's Shop 
using Trade Points 3 times!

name: Use Zeni at Baba's Shop.
description:
At the Zeni Shop you can use Zeni instead of 
Trade Points to purchase items. 

Purchase an item using Zeni!

name:
Link Dokkan Battle to 
your Facebook account.
description:
Linking to a Facebook account 
makes it easy to transfer game 
data to a new device quickly. 
Your data will also be kept safe, 
just in case something happens 
to your current device. 
Select "Device Transfer/Back 
Up" from the menu.

name:
[Daily] Clear 
"Turtle School Training" once!
description:
Clear the "Turtle School 
Training!" event 1 time!

Complete it and claim the 
rewards by 15:59:59 PST
of each day.

name:
[Daily] 
Clear a stage 3 times!
description:
Pick any stage you like and 
clear it three times! 

Complete it and claim the 
rewards by 15:59:59 PST
of each day.

name:
[Daily] Perform 1 
Summon on Friend Summon.
description:
Go to "Friend Summon" and 
perform 1 Summon! 
 
Complete it and claim the 
rewards by 15:59:59 PST
of each day.

name: [Daily] Get stronger by Training
description:
Give any of your characters 
a Training!  

Complete it and claim the 
rewards by 15:59:59 PST
of each day.

name:
[Daily] Purchase goods at 
Baba's Shop with Trade Pts!
description:
Purchase goods at Baba's Shop 
with Trade Pts!  Please note that 
purchasing “0 Trade Pt" items 
and unlocking a Trade Slot will 
not complete the mission.  

Complete it and claim the 
rewards by 15:59:59 PST
of each day.

name:
[Daily] Consume at least 
50 STA (weekend only)!
description:
冒険やイベントで
ACTを一日合計50以上
消費してみましょう!
※天下一武道会で
消費されたACTは
含まれません。

条件達成と報酬受取は
各日の23:59:59まで
となります。

name:
Use a Max-Lv. character as 
a Training Partner.
description:
The EXP a character gains from a Training Partner 
depends on the partner's level. 

Try using a character whose level is maxed out 
as a Training Partner!

name: Level up a Super Attack.
description:
When training a character, select specific 
characters as Training Partners to raise 
Super Attack level.

The higher a Super Attack's level, the more 
powerful it is!

Try raising a character's Super Attack level!

name: Z-Awaken an AGL-Type character.
description:
Perform a Z-Awakening to raise a 
character's Rarity as well as powering up 
the character's Type. 

The maximum level will also increase. 

Let's try Z-Awakening an AGL Type character.

name: Z-Awaken a STR-Type character.
description:
Perform a Z-Awakening to raise a 
character's Rarity as well as powering up 
the character's Type. 

The maximum level will also increase. 

Let's try Z-Awakening a STR Type character.

description:

character's Rarity as well as powering up 
the character's Type.

Let's try Z-Awakening a PHY Type character.

description:

character's Rarity as well as powering up 
the character's Type.

description:

The maximum level will also increase. 

Let's try Z-Awakening a TEQ Type character.

name: Create 5 Super Type characters.
description:
High-rank Types reached through Z-Awakening 
outperform standard Types. 
 
An attack that typically inflicts great damage 
against a standard Type enemy will do less 
damage against a high-rank Type enemy. 

Turn 5 characters into Super Types!

name: Create 5 Extreme Type characters.
description:
Super and Extreme Types are high-rank Types that 
work in opposition to each other. 

Take AGL and STR for example. A Super AGL 
attack against an Extreme STR will inflict more 
damage than a Super AGL attack against 
a Super STR. 

Turn 5 characters into Extreme Types!

name:

50000 Zeni acquired.
description:
Clear any stage with at least 50000 Zeni acquired! 

Look out for the Zeni tiles and finish the battle.

name:
Clear a stage with 5 or more 
Support Items acquired.
description:
The blue Hoi-Poi Capsules that appear on the map

Come join the Quests and Events, and clear any

description:

name: Make 25 Friends.
description:
The more friends you have to depend on, the 
easier it is to get through those troubling times. 

Make at least 25 friends!

name: Use King.
description:
The Support Item "King" can raise all allies' Ki 
by 1 for 3 turns. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use Launch (Normal).
description:
The Support Item "Launch (Normal)" can raise 
the attacking allies' Ki by a random amount. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name: Use Bulma.
description:
The Support Item "Bulma" can raise all allies' 
ATK and DEF by 20% for 3 turns. 

Use one in a "Quest" or "Event"! 

* This mission will not be completed when you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest.

name:
Form a team with a combined 
ATK of 20000 or higher.
description:
Focusing your team lineup on the ATK stat 
is the name of this test. 

Form a team with a combined ATK of 20000 or 
more and clear any stage from "Quest" or "Event"!

name:
Form a team with a combined 
HP of 25000 or higher.
description:
High HP increases the odds of outlasting your 
enemy. 

Form a team with a combined HP of 25000 or more

name:

the Link Skill "Z Fighters."

name: Log in for 30 days total.
description:
The login bonus for the 30th day is two types of 
valuable Awakening Medals. 

Log in to the game for 30 days in total!

name: Defeat 100 Saibaimen.
description:
Come join the Quests and Events, 
and defeat 100 Saibaimen! 
 
* Count will not be added if you 
lose a battle or abandon a quest. 
* Some events, such as "Mow 'em Down! 
Training with Saibaimen", are excluded.

name: Have Shenron grant 4 wishes.
description:
You won't find Dragon Balls in other places 
unless you make a wish. 

You can have 4 wishes granted by clearing 
Areas up to and including Area 9!

name: Use 500 STA Points.
description: Consume at least 500 STA!

name: Reach Rank 20.
description:
Quest stages on HARD and Z-HARD raise your 
Player Rank faster than the ones on NORMAL. 

Try to reach Rank 20!

name: Reach Rank 30.
description:
The Guests and Friends you can choose to 
accompany you in quests will be affected 
by your Rank. 

The higher your Rank is, the stronger they will be! 

Try to reach Rank 30!

name:
Unlock the Hidden Potential 
Activation feature!
description:
Unlock the feature "Hidden Potential"! 
Your characters can be powered up 
to a state beyond the max level limit!

name:
Power up through 
Hidden Potential!
description:
Activate an HP, ATK or DEF node in 
Hidden Potential! 

Keep activating nodes little by little, 
and you'll start to see huge 
improvements in no time!

name: Activate a Hidden Potential Skill.
description:
Activate any Hidden Potential Skill! 

Don't hesitate! Just activate it now!

name: Unlock a Potential Route.
description:
Unlock any of the four Hidden Potential routes!

You can unlock routes with specific characters!

name: Obtain a Potential Orb.
description:
Collect Potential Orbs! Potential Orbs
of any Type or kind will do!

The best places to collect them are
events like the Limited-Attempts
Event "Activate Your Hidden Potential"!

name:
Attain 1,000 HP in 
Hidden Potential.
description:
Increase a character's HP by 1,000 through 
Hidden Potential activation! 

The lower-right and lower-left routes in 
Hidden Potential can grant benefits in raising HP.

name:
Attain 1,000 ATK in 
Hidden Potential.
description:
Increase a character's ATK by 1,000 through 
Hidden Potential activation! 

The lower-right and upper-right routes in 
Hidden Potential can grant benefits in raising ATK.

name:
Attain 1,000 DEF in 
Hidden Potential.
description:
Increase a character's DEF by 1,000 through 
Hidden Potential activation! 

The lower-right and lower-left routes in 
Hidden Potential can grant benefits in raising DEF.

name:
Level up a Hidden 
Potential Skill to Lv. 5.
description:
Level up a Hidden Potential Skill of any character 
to Lv. 5! 

Any of the seven skills is fine!

name: Perform a Reverse.
description:
You can use the Reverse function to revert 
a character to the pre-Dokkan Awakened state. 

However, this only works on transcended UR or LR 
characters.

name:
Perform a Reverse 
Dokkan Awakening.
description:
Reverse Dokkan Awakening restores a Reversed 
character back to the Dokkan Awakened state. 

No Awakening Medals or Zeni required!

name:
Attain 3,000 HP in 
Hidden Potential.
description:
Increase a character's HP by 3,000 through 
Hidden Potential activation! 

The deeper you go into the Hidden Potential 
map, the higher the stats are raised!

name:

description:

description:

Any node on any character counts, so 
hop to it and get activating those nodes!

Play Hard! Turtle School's Intensive Training", 
which allows you to level up Link Skills easily, 
once! 

You'll receive Awakening Medals required for 
Z-Awakening as a reward!

name: Undergo Training.
panel_name: Undergo Training.
description:
Other than battles, you can also obtain 
character EXP from Training. 

Head to the "Team" menu and train 
any character! 

You'll receive items that allow you to 
increase the number of characters 
you can own as a reward!

name: Z-Awaken a character.
panel_name: Z-Awaken a character.
description:
Z-Awaken any character! 

* Extreme Z-Awakening excluded. 

You'll be able to recruit Elder Kai, who 
guarantees to level up a character's 
Super Attack by 1 when being selected 
as the character's Training Partner!

name:
Change the Training Location and 
undergo Training.
panel_name:
Change the 
Training Location and 
undergo Training.
description:
The Training Location can be changed 
on the "Training" page. 
 
The EXP earned can be increased by 
changing the Training Location. 
 
Tap "Training Location" on the "Training" 
page to change the Training Location! 
 
* You can choose any character to train. 
* For more details, please tap the "What is 
training?" button located on the top right 
corner of the "Select Training Char." page. 
 
You'll receive Dragon Stones and other items 
as a reward!

name: Sell a Hercule Statue.
panel_name: Sell a Hercule Statue.
description:
Selling Hercule Statues is a good way 
to get a lot of Zeni. 

Sell one from the "Team" menu! 

You'll recruit Elder Kai (Dozing), who has 
a 30% chance of raising your character's 
Super Attack level by 1!

name: Level up a Super Attack through Training.
panel_name:
Level up a Super Attack 
through Training.
description:
Selecting specific characters as 
Training Partners levels up the Training 
Character's Super Attack, making the 
Training Character more powerful.

There are also characters like Elder Kai 
who can level up Super Attacks.

Tap a slot at the "Training Partners" section 
on the "Training" page and select a character 
from the "Super Attack Lv. Up" tab!

* You can choose any character to train. 
* For more details, please tap the "What Is 
Training?" button located on the top right 
corner of the Training Character-selection 
page.

You'll receive Dragon Stones and other items 
as a reward!

description:

to Lv. 5 or above!

according to the number of days logged in, 
the amount of STA consumed and the 
number of Daily Missions completed.

specified level, this mission will be completed 
when the Pixel Character gains EXP. 

Please note that a Pixel Character's level 
will reset and the character will return to 
the initial state after a set period of time 
has elapsed.

of the home screen to check My Profile.

for more details:

name: Reach Rank 5.
description:
It's high time you completed a 
Quest! Best if you start on an 
easier difficulty, raise your Rank
nice and steadily, then you'll be 
ready for any new Quests that 
come along!

Try to reach Rank 5!

name: Reach Rank 10.
description:
Completing Quests will grant you 
EXP that will raise your Rank. 
And as your Rank goes up, your
maximum STA and Team Cost 
will increase too!

Try to reach Rank 10!

name: Reach Rank 15.
description:
Did you know that you can get 
Dragon Stones for completing 
Quests? Better get out there and
challenge yourself on some 
stages!

Try to reach Rank 15!

name: Reach Rank 20.
description:
I'm sure you've been powering up 
your characters, but make sure 
you don't neglect your own Rank!
Compared to NORMAL, stages 
on HARD and Z-HARD grant 
more EXP and make it easier 
to raise that Rank!

Try to reach Rank 20!

name: Reach Rank 25.
description:
Are you feeling restricted by your 
max Team Cost? Well if you want 
to put some powerful new
characters in your team, you'll 
need to raise your Rank first!

Try to reach Rank 25!

name: Reach Rank 30.
description:
Your Rank helps determine 
which Guests you can take 
along with you. 
The higher your Rank, 
the stronger the players you 
can access!

Try to reach Rank 30!

name: Reach Rank 35.
description:
Did you know you can collect 
Support Items during Quests? 
Take part in plenty of Events and 
collect as many different kinds of 
Support Items as you can!

Try to reach Rank 35!

name: Reach Rank 40.
description:
Have you heard of the Event 
"Pan's Secret Adventure"? 
If you want to raise your 
Rank in record time, 
then this Event is for you!

Try to reach Rank 40!

name: Reach Rank 45.
description:
Do you feel like the enemies are 
getting tougher? Well they are! 
As you progress through the 
Quests, the enemies will get 
stronger and stronger! 
Raise your Rank and try 
to include characters of higher
rarity in your team!

Try to reach Rank 45!
